title: PB2 E627K across host species — human gain vs cattle bypass vs avian ANP32A support
caption: Panel A: in human-cell minireplicons, PB2 E627K introduced into the avian euDG 2.3.4.4b polymerase raises activity far above both the native euDG and reconstructed bovine B3.13 (qualitative ordering, log scale; matthew2025). Panel B: the same substitution plays different roles per host — a major gain in humans, largely absent in cattle B3.13 where adaptation runs through PB2 M631L (+PA K497R), and unnecessary in birds where ANP32A's 33-aa insert already supports the 627E polymerase.
